subject: Tutor assistant: tutor graph, tools, assistant-ui + Streamdown chat, canvas, page context, sessions/memory/context budgeting
body: Brief: docs/segments/14-tutor-assistant.md (incl. the Sessions/memory/context-window and Libraries sections: langmem + LangChain summarization, no mem0/LiteLLM). Own cloud session (Opus). Builds on S04 (llm.py, Aegra host, search), S07, S08, S09 (active_exam), S10 (assistant ask registry contract 20261117T004342), S11, S12a/12b, S13 (in progress — coordinate on the ledger). Day one: post the canvas registry and tool registry contracts for S15/15b. Never leak answers; exam mode silent (server-derived); write tools behind interrupts. Follow docs/REVIEW_CHECKLIST.md + the integration gate.
